title: Doozy Vape Co Caramel Tobacco Nicotine Salts
description: Super-satisfying with an irresistible, subtle sweetness, this sublime ejuice from Doozy Vape Co. delivers all the rich, smoky flavour of real tobacco, softened by the sweet, soothing notes of dark caramel. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
